extracted.name: Garlic cheese finger
instruction_lines: Take maida in bowl add salt, black pepper and chilli flix. mix melted butter just like bread texture add water make dough. Keep aside for 10 minutes.
Take dough roll it in roti shape. Spread miyonees and tomato sauce mixture and then chopped garlic, organo and then grated mozrella cheese.
Fold the half semi circle and cut into the strips and fold zig zag shape and put on baking tawa.
Pre -heat the microwave on 180 degree and bake for 25 minutes. Yummy and crispy Garlic cheese sticks is ready.
